summary: Biên dịch TypeScript thành mã native (C/C++), cho phép chạy với hiệu suất cao mà không cần runtime.
usecases: Compile TypeScript scripts for performance-critical applications without Node.js runtime.
Create standalone executables from TypeScript code for desktop or server deployment.
Enable type-safe scripting in embedded systems or environments where Node.js is unavailable.
ideas: Combine with Vercel edge functions to compile TS on-the-fly for edge deployment.
Build a native TypeScript-based CLI tool that competes with Go or Rust CLI utilities.
Use as a transpiler for TypeScript to WebAssembly with native bindings.
